mapper.sql: m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.id = #{materialId} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND v.id = #{versionId} AND v.material_id = m.id AND v.ingest_state IN ('PROCESSING', 'READY', 'PARTIAL')

choose.otherwise: r.id = (SELECT newest.id FROM material_processing_revision newest WHERE newest.version_id = v.id ORDER BY newest.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1)

mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, r.revision_no, v.ingest_state, r.state AS revision_state, r.stage AS revision_stage, r.progress, r.excluded_pages_json, p.page_no, p.width, p.height, p.native_text_status, p.ocr_status, p.ocr_quality, p.visual_status, p.error_code, CASE WHEN canonical.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS canonical_available, CASE WHEN image.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS preview_available FROM material m JOIN material_version v ON v.material_id = m.id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.version_id = v.id LEFT JOIN material_page p ON p.revision_id = r.id LEFT JOIN material_page_artifact canonical ON canonical.revision_id = r.id AND canonical.page_no = p.page_no AND canonical.artifact_kind = 'CANONICAL_PAGE' LEFT JOIN material_page_artifact image ON image.revision_id = r.id AND image.page_no = p.page_no AND image.artifact_kind = 'PAGE_IMAGE' WHERE AND ORDER BY p.page_no

SELECT image.object_key, image.object_version_id, image.content_sha256, image.byte_size, image.content_type FROM material m JOIN material_version v ON v.material_id = m.id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.version_id = v.id JOIN material_page p ON p.revision_id = r.id AND p.page_no = #{pageNo} JOIN material_page_artifact image ON image.revision_id = r.id AND image.page_no = p.page_no AND image.artifact_kind = 'PAGE_IMAGE' WHERE AND LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, v.page_count, v.content_sha256, r.id AS latest_revision_id, r.revision_no AS latest_revision_no, r.state AS latest_revision_state, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, r.worker_profile_fingerprint, r.parser_version, r.cleaner_version, r.chunk_schema_version, r.ocr_version, r.vlm_schema_version, r.excluded_pages_json FROM material m JOIN material_version v ON v.id = m.latest_version_id AND v.material_id = m.id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.version_id = v.id WHERE m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.id = #{materialId} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND v.ingest_state IN ('READY', 'PARTIAL', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY r.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, r.revision_no, v.ingest_state, r.state AS revision_state, r.stage AS revision_stage, r.progress, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, r.excluded_pages_json, r.error_code FROM material_reprocess_request request JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = request.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = request.version_id AND v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = request.material_id AND m.id = v.material_id WHERE m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.id = #{materialId} AND request.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND request.request_fingerprint = #{requestFingerprint} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE material_processing_revision SET state = #{state}, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{revisionId} AND state = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, r.revision_no, v.ingest_state, r.state AS revision_state, r.stage AS revision_stage, r.progress, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, r.excluded_pages_json, r.error_code FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id WHERE m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND v.id = #{versionId} AND r.fingerprint = #{processingFingerprint} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, r.revision_no, v.ingest_state, r.state AS revision_state, r.stage AS revision_stage FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id WHERE m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND r.id = #{revisionId} LIMIT 1
